description.value:
You make a melee tech attack against a creature you touch. On a miss, the power ends with no effect. On a hit, you deal 2d6 kinetic damage as you attach an explosive charge to the target. As a bonus action on a later turn, you can detonate the charge, ending the power; detonating it on the same turn it was planted deals 1d8 fire damage, while waiting until your next turn deals 2d8 fire damage, increasing by 1d8 for each additional round you delay, to a maximum of 6d8. If the power ends before you detonate the charge, no fire damage is dealt.

A creature carrying the charge can use its action to try to remove it, making a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your tech save DC; success ends the power harmlessly.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the initial kinetic damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level beyond 1st.
